principles: Teach spelling as encoding speech and meaning into writing, not as visual memorisation alone.
Teach explicit sound-grapheme, orthographic and meaningful morphological structures as applicable.
Use human reviewed sound recordings and annotations; never map arbitrary displayed chunks to phonemes.
Distinguish assisted learning, immediate unaided spelling, delayed unaided recall and transfer.
Age affects appearance and default controls, never word difficulty.
Review learner errors to choose targeted re-teaching rather than repeat the same generic lesson.
Do not infer fixed learning styles or experimentally prefer an unvalidated programme based on one trial.

curriculum_domains.name: Oral phoneme and syllable awareness
curriculum_domains.note: Speech sounds must be linguistically verified; not always one-to-one with letters.

curriculum_domains.name: Orthographic patterns and conventions
curriculum_domains.note: Avoid stating broad rules without exceptions.

curriculum_domains.name: Spoken syllables and stress
curriculum_domains.note: Do not equate spelling chunks with syllables.

curriculum_domains.name: Word-specific choices
curriculum_domains.note: Identify regular parts and exceptional parts, use accurate reviewed explanation.

curriculum_domains.name: Independent transfer and retention
curriculum_domains.note: Focus on retained independent ability not points.

error_taxonomy.signal: Target phoneme apparently absent in learner attempt
error_taxonomy.review: Expert-confirmed phoneme alignment needed; automated string matching alone insufficient
error_taxonomy.response: Model spoken phoneme then its grapheme

error_taxonomy.review: Check target syllable and sound annotations
error_taxonomy.response: Blend and segment with accurate audio

error_taxonomy.signal: Different plausible grapheme for a sound

error_taxonomy.response: Explain the spelling choice; build contrasting words

error_taxonomy.signal: Base, prefix or suffix written incorrectly
Vowel/letter issue in reduced or unstressed syllable
error_taxonomy.review: Accurate stress and pronunciation from educator
error_taxonomy.response: Explicit spelling and meaningful word family

error_taxonomy.review: Word record includes exception and optional mnemonic
error_taxonomy.response: Teach choice explicitly and retrieve again

error_taxonomy.signal: Accidental tap or keypress rather than a spelling misconception
error_taxonomy.review: Learner correction or repeat supports inference
error_taxonomy.response: Offer undo and accessible input, do not mark mastery down without checking

error_taxonomy.signal: Not enough evidence for a reliable error mechanism
error_taxonomy.response: Reveal exact mismatch, offer teacher-reviewed explanation without diagnostic guess

adaptive_rules.initial_difficulty: independent diagnostic tasks only, never learner age
adaptive_rules.after_error: Identify target using expert annotated word data; loop to smallest relevant UNDERSTAND/EXPLAIN/BUILD stage.
adaptive_rules.after_assisted_success: Fade scaffold and obtain independent spelling.
adaptive_rules.after_immediate_success: Schedule delayed independent recall before durable mastery.
adaptive_rules.after_delayed_success: Extend spacing heuristically and test transfer where meaningful.
adaptive_rules.when_audio_is_unreviewed: Suppress sound-level teaching; word cannot be promoted to approved.
adaptive_rules.experimental_davis_inspired: Not part of default curriculum unless consent and reviewed protocol; never replace foundational instruction.

release_gate_checklist: Word spelling and en-GB pronunciation checked
Phonemes / syllables / graphemes / orthography / morphemes separately annotated
Instructional targets and any mnemonics approved
All narrated instructions and spoken chunks listened to and signed off
Assistance and delayed recall classified correctly
